messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Ansh Bargoti
ansh bargoti... that's a name with some weight to it. where you working these days?
Flipkart

flipkart... the og indian e-commerce giant that's still standing after amazon tried to bulldoze the market. respect.

found you on linkedin - ansh bargoti. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/ansh-bargoti-89751b221
No
my bad, getting the same result. can't find you with flipkart in the mix. drop your linkedin url or send me your resume - need one of those to find you the right roles
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ansh-bargoti?utm_source=share&utm_campaign=share_via&utm_content=profile&utm_medium=ios_app

got you! flipkart supply chain... keeping the wheels of indian commerce spinning. that's some serious operational muscle you're flexing there.

what made you get into supply chain? seems like you could've gone the traditional tech route but chose the backbone instead
Hmmm I wanted to work on some things where I could make a difference

makes sense. supply chain is where the real impact happens - millions of packages reaching doorsteps because you optimized a route or fixed a bottleneck. way more tangible than pushing pixels around.

how long you been working total?
Bruh

Since 2022
 Till aug 2022 as intern 
Then fte

so about 2.5 years in the game. solid foundation to build on.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Software Developer

wait hold up... supply chain to software dev? that's a proper career pivot. 

what's driving this switch? got tired of logistics and want to build the systems instead of managing them?

lmaooo fair, i'm being nosy. but seriously though - supply chain to dev is not a small jump. you coding on the side or is this a "i want to learn programming" situation?

either way, bangalore or open to remote/other cities?

I’m working as software engineer only 
Role might look application engi but I’m working as dev only

ahhhh got it. classic flipkart title confusion. "application engineer" but you're shipping code, not managing supply chains. the eternal startup title game.

so you want a proper "software developer" title that matches what you're actually doing. makes total sense.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Open to remove and Bangalore Hyderabad or Uttar pradesh
2.5 years + software development + remote/bangalore/hyderabad/UP... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

legend! you're officially in the tal system now 🔥

roles are gonna start flowing in based on your profile - proper software dev positions that match your 2.5 years of real experience. none of that "application engineer" nonsense.

flipkart to something better... this is gonna be fun to watch unfold
Okk
perfect. now we wait for the good stuff to roll in.
What’s 2+3
5. why?

What came before
Egg or chicken

egg. laid by something that wasn't quite a chicken yet. evolution's a slow game.

you bored or just testing me?
Bored
fair enough. job hunting's a waiting game. anything specific you're looking for or just seeing what's out there?
Anything fun we can do
we could set up a daily ping for new roles? or i could roast your resume if you want to share it.
Okk
which one? daily ping or resume roast?

Nvm 
Whenever u get something just ping me
got it. i'll ping when something good comes through.
Cool

hey, walmart global tech has a software engineer III role in bangalore

hybrid setup (2-3 days office) and they're working on supply chain/customer experience stuff

you think you could swing the 3-6 years experience requirement with your flipkart background?

hey, walmart global tech has another software engineer III role in bangalore

they're looking for 3-6 years but your flipkart background might bridge that gap

working on systems for millions of customers globally
